notes: Hostile source-only fidelity audit against data/bill-text/119-HR-998.txt (Public Law 119-39, full text, 5764 chars; no referencedSources registered). Every substantive prose field decomposed to atomic claims. No material errors: all figures (font size 14, 180 days, 18 months, 12 months, credit sections 24/25A/32/35/36B), citations (new 6213(b)(1)(B), new 6213(b)(2)(C)), directions (all additive), and entities verify verbatim against source. Three minor open items: (1) underreported[0] hardens the source's 'should be listed' to 'must be listed' (modal overstatement); (2) sponsor/cosponsor line in likelihoodReason is Congress.gov metadata not in bill source; (3) 'drew no recorded opposition' is a breadth-of-support inference from voice/UC passage, not stated in source. Two minor omissions: National Taxpayer Advocate consultation (2(e)); abatement-deadline placement 'immediately next to the taxpayer's address' (2(a) V).
